hooks.command: r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); [ -f "$r/backend/pyproject.toml" ] || r=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}; if command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then e=$(git -C "$r" config user.email 2>/dev/null); case "$e" in *noreply*) ;; *) echo "WARN: git user.email (${e:-unset}) is not a GitHub noreply address. If the GitHub account you push with blocks command-line pushes that expose a private email, the push is rejected (GH007)." ;; esac; fi; [ -x "$r/backend/.venv/bin/python" ] || echo "WARN: no backend virtualenv in this worktree ($r/backend/.venv). Create it with: (cd \"$r/backend\" && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]')"; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.py|*.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) d=$(dirname "$f"); t=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); n=$(awk 'END { print NR }' "$f" 2>/dev/null); if [ -f "$t/backend/pyproject.toml" ] && [ "${n:-0}" -gt 300 ]; then b=$(git -C "$d" show "HEAD:./$(basename "$f")" 2>/dev/null | awk 'END { print NR }'); if [ "${b:-0}" -le 300 ] || [ "$n" -gt "$b" ]; then if [ "${b:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then h="$b at HEAD"; else h="not in HEAD"; fi; jq -cn --arg m "$f: $n lines ($h) exceeds the repository's 300-line-per-file convention. Advisory, not enforced by any check: put added code in a new or smaller module where practical; do not split or restructure existing code unless the task asks." '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: $m}}'; fi; fi ;; esac; exit 0
